briefing.headline: Speed brain: Slow charts
good: Other brains: LOCK-IN spike wave: edge sentinel: 15 people-fetches in 15 min vs ~5.3 normal · Money brain: Checkout leak · Data brain: Over budget · Security brain: Headless flood · Content brain: Gaps · Traffic brain: Surge
watch: Admin: Chart pages: the slowest 10% of real loads take 12s — phones 3s vs desktop 12s (46% of loads on phones); the server answers in 0.2s and candles in 0.06s (HIT) — the time is on the visitor's side. NETWORK, not device: US loads 0.46s at p90, the slow 10% are far/slow connections — IN 15s ×83, PH 95s ×11, IR 34s ×20, PK 13s ×28, NG 8.02s ×19. The lever is first-load weight (a lighter first chart bundle / fewer candles on slow links), a build session. A headless flood is on (US: 186 raw vs ~9.6, 2 stayed, CN: 161 raw vs ~5.7, 0 stayed, GB: 78 raw vs ~6, 0 stayed, CA: 58 raw vs ~0.9, 1 stayed) — its loads pollute the desktop number; trust phones until it stops. Most slow-load time sits in: desktop/IN 21s ×48, mobile/IR 23s ×12, mobile/PK 16s ×15, mobile/IN 5.1s ×35.
